description: Capability for plugin windows only. It grants exactly the five host capabilities a plugin may call (allow-plugin-capabilities) and nothing else. Host commands are deliberately absent: the ability to call them lives in the `default` capability, which never matches plugin_* labels. Keep the two command sets disjoint — verify-acl.mjs asserts it, and a shared permission set would mean every new host command also becomes a plugin capability. The one core permission is window dragging: frameless plugin windows have no OS title bar, so their custom title bar calls plugin:window|start_dragging; it is scoped to the caller's own window label, which the host fixes as plugin_<id>.
